caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a fluted baking mold with a central tube, resembling a Bundt pan. The mold has a round shape with scalloped sides and a raised central core, which is hexagonal at the top. The exterior and interior surfaces of the mold are rendered with detailed vertical lines and variations in shading, giving the appearance of a metallic or glazed ceramic texture. The colors used are predominantly shades of brown, with hints of yellow and green patches, suggesting a mottled or aged surface. The background is a plain, light beige color, which isolates and emphasizes the object. The artist's signature, "Richard Barnett," is visible in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Cake Mold
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
